messages.author: 0d7828fe34b3b04f
messages.subject: Correction for Shiny Server v0.4.0.0 Administrator's Guide
parts:
Hi, 

First of all, thank you for the great work.  It's really incredible.

I installed Shiny Server at work, and while following the Shiny Server v0.4.0.0 Administrator's Guide, I found a minor error (missing words colored in red below) in the section 2.5.3 Host Per-User Application Directories as follows:

For instance, if tina is a user on this system and is also a member of the shinyUsers group, any application stored in /home/tina/ShinyApps/shinyApp1 would be available on this server at a URL like http://server.com/userApps/tina/shinyApp1, assuming /home/tina was tina's home directory.

Hope this helps.


Jeong
